submitted.rationale: Index 20 (Sb 0.624) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0559%. The line was sampled at Sb 0.36, 0.50, 0.62, 0.67 and 0.71. EQE rises from the Pb-rich side, is highest between Sb 0.62 and 0.67, and falls at 0.71. The Sb-rich end near PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.667) looks like the productive region. MEGNet HSE gaps are about 2.7 eV for PbSb2O6 and 2.5 eV for the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore, so both should absorb 3.2 eV light.
